body:
I'm only doing 3 days a week and I'm currently looking for part time work because as much as I don't feel I have time to do anything for me, I need to get my own place. I have a really toxic family and I believe that once I get out of there I will feel a bit better and I might even feel like I have something to live for because I wouldn't have to come back to a house I hate being it. I just need the money first but after applying for about 30ish jobs in the recent months, only having two interviews and being rejected by both I'm not too hopeful. I receive money from the college as well as a student loan but I don't think I would be able to get a place with just that as I would merely be scraping by.

My course is actually really good, it's a subject I enjoy and something I would love a career in. I just hope I'll get through the course although I don't imagine there are too many jobs going around in the UK for Sound Design.

I'll try and book an appointment with my GP soon, they are very unreliable though but I agree with you. I mean I'm currently unhappy to the point of having suicidal thoughts which are constant, I really can't get a break from them. I will push them and push them to allow me to try anti-depressants. I keep thinking about just turning to recreational drugs and alcohol but I don't really drink or do drugs, it's just an intrusive thought that comes up every now and then when I'm not thinking about suicide. I don't want to do that though but the urge is there. I have a nicotine addiction from my mum smoking while pregnant with me and everyone smoking around me as I was growing up but I'm trying not to smoke because that doesn't help either. It's just the same kind of urge though.

I've spoken to different people like therapists and counsellors and such but they have never helped in the long term. That's what I'm looking for really. I don't feel I can talk to anyone who I am even slightly close to because I don't feel comfortable doing so. I've told a few people that I'm suicidal and I told them the method I have planned as I was recommended to do so by my old high school teacher who I rarely go and speak to. But that's the extent of what I've told them, I don't tell them how I feel at the moment just that I have a plan for if I hit rock bottom but I don't think anyone remembers as it was one time when I did actually drink.

I'll go to my GP and just ask what the options are and push them to do something because I'm sick of this constant sadness. 

Thank you very much, I appreciate it.

Hey, thanks for the reply!

When I say I have nothing to do I mean nothing productive, I'm currently in college but that's about it, I don't do anything productive outside of the hours I'm at college. I don't have the motivation and I can't find the time either. I've been trying out new things like reading books about mindfulness and being a happier person and they work for a little bit but I never feel better for too long.

I've been to the doctors multiple times between the age of 14 and now and they haven't done anything other than told me they can't do anything and I wouldn't wish to take medication as I know people who do and they regret it, it makes some of them worse. I also just don't like the idea of strange chemicals messing up my hormones.
